title: Sumac-style chicken salad
summary: Sumac-style chicken salad is a middle eastern dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and cucumber, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook skinless chicken breast fillets for Sumac-style chicken salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cherry tomatoes alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss cucumber with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Sumac-style chicken salad straight away. Taste Sumac-style chicken salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
